definitions.explanation: The voluntary act of donating blood for medical use. In Japan, blood donation drives are commonly conducted by the Japanese Red Cross in mobile buses and at fixed donation centers in major cities.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}で{献血|けんけつ}バスを{見|み}かけた。
examples.english: I spotted a blood donation bus in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めての{献血|けんけつ}は{少|すこ}し{緊張|きんちょう}したが、{思|おも}ったより{痛|いた}くなかった。
examples.english: I was a little nervous about my first blood donation, but it hurt less than I expected.

notes:
USAGE:
{献血|けんけつ} is commonly used with する to form the verb phrase {献血|けんけつ}する (to donate blood). In Japan, the {日本赤十字社|にほんせきじゅうじしゃ} (Japanese Red Cross Society) manages blood donation. Donation buses ({献血|けんけつ}バス) are a common sight near train stations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {献血|けんけつ}する (to donate blood)
- {献血|けんけつ}バス (blood donation bus)
- {献血|けんけつ}センター (blood donation center)
- {献血|けんけつ}カード (blood donor card)
